# freecenter Provider

Manage ESXi free hosts and their virtual machines through a FreeCenter server. Authenticate with a token, or with a user name and password. Changes require an administrator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    freecenter = { source = "fdaforno/freecenter" }
  }
}

# Credentials can also come from the environment:
# FREECENTER_ADDRESS, FREECENTER_USERNAME and FREECENTER_PASSWORD, or FREECENTER_TOKEN.
provider "freecenter" {
  address  = "http://freecenter.example.lan:8080"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.freecenter_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Base URL of the FreeCenter server (e.g. http://freecenter:8080). Env: FREECENTER_ADDRESS.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of username. Env: FREECENTER_PASSWORD.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API bearer token, from POST /api/v1/auth/login. A token expires after 7 days without use. Env: FREECENTER_TOKEN.
- `username` (String) User name, as an alternative to token: the provider opens the session itself. Env: FREECENTER_USERNAME.
